Five merged PRs since 2026-04-14 added or removed a line containing `hasPrivilege` under `api/src/main/java/org/openmrs`. All five are on the main line up to the pinned head (`5eb8cba`).

Best first:

1. **PR #6598** (TRUNK-6707, merged 2026-10-01). Added `if (!Context.hasPrivilege(gp.getViewPrivilege(), false))` in `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/impl/AdministrationServiceImpl.java`, inside the new `checkCanView`.
2. **PR #6383** (TRUNK-6712, merged 2026-07-24). Removed the old `hasPrivilege` bodies in `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/context/UserContext.java` and replaced them with `hasPrivilege(String, boolean)` and `resolvePrivilege`.
3. **PR #6186** (no ticket, merged 2026-06-18). Added `return Context.hasPrivilege(PrivilegeConstants.GET_ALERTS);` in `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/notification/impl/AlertServiceImpl.java`.
4. **PR #6668** (TRUNK-6802, merged 2026-10-13). Removed `if (Context.hasPrivilege(privilege))` from `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/security/OpenmrsPermissionEvaluator.java`, replacing it with `FilterPassPrivilegeCache.holdsPrivilege`.
5. **PR #6544** (TRUNK-6799, merged 2026-10-08). Added `if (Context.hasPrivilege(privilege))` in the new `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/security/OpenmrsPermissionEvaluator.java` and in the new `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/security/OpenmrsAuthorizationManagerFactory.java`.

Dates are the commit timestamps Falkon lists for each change. For squash merges these should match the merge time, but I did not check the PR metadata itself.

Commits I checked and ruled out: `3310bc1` and `1d0fb13` (UserContext proxy-privilege edits), `5eb8cba` (exception type changes), `a48d5d8` and `a69b14a` in `AuthorizationAdvice.java`, `2c9b2ee` (RolePrivilegeCache), `7b9487c` (NameSupport), `22a4bae` (UserService constant), and `c4aca3a` (adds `hasProxyPrivileges`, which does not contain the substring).

Limits of the check: I did not diff all 73 commits on the path. I covered the commits that touch the files holding `hasPrivilege` lines and those whose messages suggest privilege changes. I did not check `JobRunrSchedulerService`, which has `hasPrivilege`-style lines but no commit in the window I found touching them.
